payload.title: Contract Graph3 metric validation separately from full report authentication
payload.summary: Priority2 experiment-analysis assurance. Case0016 stage_d.validation.validate(data,result) independently checks many metric fields but accepts a flipped gate_inputs.graph_contributed_gain and arbitrary primary_answers while returning PASS with checks that claim checkpoint ancestry, capture replay and deterministic artifact replay. Independent inert-input probes reproduce both acceptances. The original analysis.expected builds its own output, and verify compares exact bytes after authentication, so no corrupted original verdict is demonstrated. Existing proposal2e70de9a owns neutral-ID/address pair binding; its advisory mention is not sufficient actionable scope for this distinct report-validation responsibility.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: preserve frozen implementations/results. For an authorized future read-only analysis consumer provide a separately versioned full-report verifier or explicitly narrow metric-only contract, with supported schema and externally anchored complete input closure. Independently challenge graph-contributed-gain in both directions, contract/ranking/reach flags, all derived answers/prose, missing/duplicate fields, altered input population and unsupported versions. A full verifier must recompute every claimed derived field without calling a treatment/model/adjudicator or loading untrusted pickle, and reject mutations even when the final harmful outcome is unchanged. A subset verifier must report only checks it actually performs and require an authenticated-input owner; do not permit it to certify publication or semantic truth. Test actual report-only caller path and unchanged original compatibility. Suitable for a bounded maintenance agent only after version and consumer approval.
payload.uncertainty: Historical expected/verify callers are safe against these isolated mutations under their exact input preconditions; no active production bypass or historical scientific invalidation is claimed. No generic evaluator, source authority or controller is authorized.
